dasha:Ketu: Ketu mahadasha: A period of detachment, spiritual interest and letting go; sudden changes can redirect your path. How Ketu is placed in your chart decides how these results come.
dasha:Venus: Venus mahadasha: A period for relationships, comfort, creativity and material growth. How Venus is placed in your chart decides how these results come.
dasha:Sun: Sun mahadasha: A period that emphasises career, authority, self-confidence and official matters. How Sun is placed in your chart decides how these results come.
dasha:Moon: Moon mahadasha: A period focused on emotions, family, home and public dealings; the mind seeks peace. How Moon is placed in your chart decides how these results come.
dasha:Mars: Mars mahadasha: A period of energy and action, good for property, courage and getting things done, with care around conflict. How Mars is placed in your chart decides how these results come.
dasha:Rahu: Rahu mahadasha: A period of ambition and unconventional opportunities, often with foreign links or rapid change. How Rahu is placed in your chart decides how these results come.
dasha:Jupiter: Jupiter mahadasha: A period of growth, learning, faith and good counsel; children and teachers may feature. How Jupiter is placed in your chart decides how these results come.
dasha:Saturn: Saturn mahadasha: A period of steady effort and responsibility; patient work brings lasting results. How Saturn is placed in your chart decides how these results come.
dasha:Mercury: Mercury mahadasha: A period for learning, communication, business and intellectual work. How Mercury is placed in your chart decides how these results come.
dosha:none: No major dosha (Manglik, Kaal Sarp, Sade Sati, Pitru, Grahan, Guru Chandal or Shrapit) is found in this chart.
dosha:manglik: Manglik (Mangal) dosha is present: Mars is in the 1st, 2nd, 4th, 7th, 8th or 12th house from the lagna. Traditionally this calls for careful matching in marriage, ideally with a partner whose chart also has Manglik dosha.
dosha:manglikCancelled: Mars is in a Manglik position, but the dosha is cancelled (bhang): Mars is in its own or exalted sign, or receives Jupiter's influence. Its effect is greatly reduced.
dosha:kaalsarp: Kaal Sarp dosha: all seven planets lie on one side of the Rahu–Ketu axis. It is linked with sudden ups and downs and delays that ease with steady effort.
dosha:sadesati: Sade Sati is running: Saturn is transiting the 12th, 1st or 2nd sign from your Moon. This 7½-year period tests patience and brings responsibilities; disciplined work is rewarded.
dosha:dhaiya: Shani Dhaiya (Kantak Shani) is running: Saturn is transiting the 4th or 8th sign from your Moon, a 2½-year period that asks for care with health, home and work.
dosha:pitru: Pitru dosha: Rahu or Ketu is in the 9th house, or the Sun is joined with Rahu. Traditionally linked with ancestral debts; it can slow fortune and family matters.
dosha:grahan: Grahan dosha: the Sun or Moon is joined with Rahu or Ketu. It can cloud confidence (Sun) or peace of mind (Moon) until it is steadied.
dosha:guruchandal: Guru Chandal dosha: Jupiter is joined with Rahu. Judgement and the guidance of teachers may be tested; follow sound advice and ethics.
dosha:shrapit: Shrapit dosha: Saturn is joined with Rahu. Efforts may feel blocked or slow to pay off; patience and service help.
remedy:dosha:manglik: Recite the Hanuman Chalisa on Tuesdays, give red lentils (masoor dal) in charity, and consider a Mangal Shanti puja. For marriage, Kumbh vivah or matching with a Manglik partner is the traditional remedy; decide with your astrologer.
remedy:dosha:kaalsarp: Chant 'Om Namah Shivaya' daily, worship on Nag Panchami, and consider a Kaal Sarp dosha puja (for example at Trimbakeshwar) after consulting your astrologer.
remedy:dosha:sadesati: On Saturdays recite the Hanuman Chalisa and the Shani mantra 'Om Sham Shanaishcharaya Namah', give mustard oil or black sesame in charity, and serve elders and workers.
remedy:dosha:dhaiya: On Saturdays chant 'Om Sham Shanaishcharaya Namah', light a mustard-oil lamp under a peepal tree, and help those who labour.
remedy:dosha:pitru: Perform shraddha and tarpan during Pitru Paksha, feed Brahmins, cows and crows, and consider Narayan Bali or Tripindi shraddha after consulting your astrologer.
remedy:dosha:grahan: For the Sun, offer water to the rising Sun; for the Moon, worship Lord Shiva on Mondays; and give charity on eclipse days.
remedy:dosha:guruchandal: Chant 'Om Brim Brihaspataye Namah' on Thursdays, respect teachers and elders, and give yellow items such as chana dal or turmeric in charity.
remedy:dosha:shrapit: Chant the Mahamrityunjaya mantra, recite the Hanuman Chalisa on Saturdays, and consider a Shani–Rahu shanti puja after consulting your astrologer.
remedy:planet:Sun: For the Sun: offer water (arghya) to the rising Sun, chant 'Om Suryaya Namah', respect your father, and give wheat or jaggery on Sundays.
remedy:planet:Moon: For the Moon: chant 'Om Chandraya Namah', worship Lord Shiva on Mondays, keep a calm routine, and give milk or rice in charity.
remedy:planet:Mars: For Mars: recite the Hanuman Chalisa on Tuesdays, chant 'Om Mangalaya Namah', and give red lentils in charity.
remedy:planet:Mercury: For Mercury: chant 'Om Budhaya Namah' on Wednesdays, feed green fodder to cows, and give green moong in charity.
remedy:planet:Jupiter: For Jupiter: chant 'Om Brim Brihaspataye Namah' on Thursdays, respect teachers, and give chana dal or turmeric in charity.
remedy:planet:Venus: For Venus: chant 'Om Shukraya Namah' on Fridays, worship Goddess Lakshmi, and give white sweets, rice or clothes in charity.
remedy:planet:Saturn: For Saturn: chant 'Om Sham Shanaishcharaya Namah' on Saturdays, recite the Hanuman Chalisa, and give mustard oil or black sesame in charity.
